# @ankhorage/mcp

![license: MIT](././paradox/badges/license.svg) ![npm: v0.1.0](././paradox/badges/npm.svg) ![runtime: bun](././paradox/badges/runtime.svg) ![typescript: strict](././paradox/badges/typescript.svg) ![eslint: checked](././paradox/badges/eslint.svg) ![prettier: checked](././paradox/badges/prettier.svg) ![build: checked](././paradox/badges/build.svg) ![tests: checked](././paradox/badges/tests.svg) ![paradox: canonical](././paradox/badges/docs.svg)

Secure, provider-neutral MCP runtime and Ankh CLI provider.

## Usage

### CLI

Ankhorage packages expose their command-line interface through `ankh`. Use `ankh --help` to discover available package commands, or run a package command with `--help` for package-specific usage.

```zsh
# Install the Ankhorage CLI
bun add --global @ankhorage/ankh

# Show usage information for mcp
ankh mcp --help
```

### Basic Usage

`@ankhorage/mcp` centrally registers provider tools and enforces their declared account scope.
Providers supply integrations through their published `./mcp` export; the runtime owns discovery,
validation, approval enforcement, and transport.

```ts
export const registry = createMcpRegistry({
  integrations: [
    {
      id: 'example',
      tools: [
        {
          description: 'Read account metadata.',
          executeAsync: () => Promise.resolve({ status: 'ok' }),
          id: 'account-status',
          inputSchema: {
            additionalProperties: false,
            properties: { accountId: { type: 'string' } },
            required: ['accountId'],
            type: 'object',
          },
          risk: 'read',
          scope: 'account',
          title: 'Account status',
          accountId: (input) =>
            typeof input.accountId === 'string' ? input.accountId : null,
        },
      ],
    },
  ],
});
```
